reason: Behavior is backward compatible since UseLocalTime defaults to false (preserving UTC-based scheduling), and the switch from CanExecute/Resume to CanExecuteAsync/ResumeAsync assumes these async overrides already exist on the base Activity class, but if that base-class async infrastructure isn't already in place elsewhere this would fail to compile/behave, warranting a quick review of the base class
